question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

Paul Bunyan is considered a __legend__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**tradition.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• **"Legend" refers to a story or myth that is passed down through generations.** (दंतकथा)
 
 
• Example: The legend of King Arthur is well-known in many countries. 
 
 
 
• **"Tradition" means a custom, belief or way of doing something that has continued from the past to the present.** (परंपरा )
 
 
• Example: By tradition, people play practical jokes on 1 April.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "tradition" is the synonym of the word "legend."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Spinster''** refers to an unmarried woman especially an older women. (कुंवारी कन्या)
 
• **"Stoic"** refers to a person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining. (साहसी)
 
• **"Volunteer"** refers to a person who offers to do something without being asked or paid to do so. (स्वयंसेवक)
